text: The feedback effects that make community governance of federated learning work will not materialize unless expert community members are selected coherently, making coherent expert selection a precondition of the mechanism rather than an optional refinement.
citation: Wulf A. Kaal, How AI Models are Optimized Through Web3 Governance (2024). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=4855607

isBasedOn.name: How AI Models are Optimized Through Web3 Governance

abstract: The key is to select the expert community members coherently to allow for the feedback effects for FL to materialize.
